text: # musespark-c16-ab: pinned Muse Spark weights + DFlash2 draft into one HF cache on the node's NVMe (refs/main = the pins,
# for offline loads), and the 062126_256k corpus as a classic-layout copy of the shared hub's (same revision): the bench's
# offline `hf download` cannot resolve a huggingface_hub-2.4 layout (lesson of musespark-c1-p90-sa fixcorpus.sh and
# dsv41f-c1-p90-sa2 dsv41f-fixcorpus). Idempotent. HF token on the node host only, never in a container.
[ -x "$PYDL" ] || { python3 -m venv "$NL/dlvenv" && "$NL/dlvenv/bin/pip" -q install huggingface_hub || die "dl venv"; }
log "start; hub $HUB_NL; huggingface_hub $($PYDL -c 'import huggingface_hub as h; print(h.__version__)'); free $(df -h --output=avail "$NL" | tail -1)"
hub, m, mr, d, dr = sys.argv[1:6]
for repo, rev in ((m, mr), (d, dr)):
p = snapshot_download(repo, revision=rev, repo_type="model", cache_dir=hub, max_workers=16)
idx = [f for f in files if f.endswith(".safetensors.index.json")]
want = set(json.load(open(os.path.join(p, idx[0])))["weight_map"].values()) if idx else set()
missing = [f for f in want if not os.path.isfile(os.path.join(p, f))]
n = sum(1 for f in files if f.endswith(".safetensors"))
print(f"[dl] ok {repo}@{rev[:10]}: {n} shards, {len(files)} entries, {time.time()-t:.0f} s -> refs/main pinned", flush=True)
# corpus: the shared hub's classic copy at the pin (trees/ left out: metadata only, not readable)
a=$(find -L "$SH/snapshots" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l); b=$(find -L "$HUB_NL/$CORPUS_DIR/snapshots" -type f | wc -l)
# One before/after measurement for musespark-c16-ab: serve the container's current SGLang tree with a launch config, on a
# fresh server, as Arbor's SGLang launcher builds it (python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path M --served-model-name M
# --host 0.0.0.0 --port P <server_flags>, the config's server_env, ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<gpus>, HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES unset);
# run the AgentX replay (bench/bench_agentx.sh = musespark-c1-p90-sa's pack bench, InferenceX 86699be610 client) at C16
# for DURATION s, then GSM8K (sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k); stop that server (its own process group only).
# Adapted from musespark-c1-p90-sa/ab.sh, with the fixes found in dsv41f-c1-p90-sa2: a missing bench_output.json or a
# missing GSM8K accuracy exits 1. The server env is the recipe's only; the bench variables go to the bench alone.
# usage: bash ab.sh <tag> <config.json> <duration_s> <gsm8k_questions>    e.g.  before configs/before.json 3600 1319
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "curl -sf -m 3 localhost:$PORT/health >/dev/null" && die "a server already answers on port $PORT"

docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "cd $WORKSPACE_ROOT && git log -2 --format='%h %s' && echo '--- status:' && git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no && echo '--- vs baseline:' && git diff --stat \$(git log --format=%h --grep='^baseline:' -1) HEAD | tail -3" > "$OUT_H/tree.txt" 2>&1
cfg, envf, benchf, serve, gpus, port, dur, outc, conc, image = sys.argv[1:11]
for k, v in c["server_env"].items(): f.write(f"export {k}={shlex.quote(v)}\n")
# The bench's variables: the recipe's benchmark env, plus what bench_agentx.sh / InferenceX read (same for before and after).
for k, v in bench.items(): f.write(f"export {k}={shlex.quote(v)}\n")
log "$TAG: config $(basename "$CFG"); tree $(head -1 "$OUT_H/tree.txt" | cut -c1-80); GPUs $GPUS port $PORT; AgentX C$CONC ${DUR}s; GSM8K $NQ"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" pgrep -f "sglang.launch_server .*--port $PORT " >/dev/null || { log "$TAG: FATAL server died"; tail -30 "$OUT_H/server.log"; exit 1; }
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "curl -sf -m 5 localhost:$PORT/health >/dev/null" || { log "$TAG: FATAL not healthy after 40 min"; tail -20 "$OUT_H/server.log"; exit 1; }
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "pid=\$(pgrep -f 'sglang.launch_server .*--port $PORT ' | head -1); [ -n \"\$pid\" ] && kill -TERM -- -\$(ps -o pgid= -p \$pid | tr -d ' ') 2>/dev/null; sleep 30; \
for p in \$(pgrep -f '[s]glang'); do grep -qa 'ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$GPUS' /proc/\$p/environ 2>/dev/null && kill -9 \$p; done; true"
log "$TAG: AgentX rc=$? after $(( $(date +%s) - T1 )) s: $(grep -a '^\[bench_agentx\] p90_intvty' "$OUT_H/bench.log" | tail -1)"
python3 - "$OUT_H/bench_output.json" <<'PY' || { log "$TAG: FATAL AgentX produced no bench_output.json (see $OUT_H/bench.log)"; exit 1; }
except Exception as e: sys.exit(f"[ab] no bench_output.json: {e}")
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "cd /tmp && timeout 5400 python3 -m sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k --num-questions $NQ --port $PORT --parallel 64" > "$OUT_H/gsm8k.log" 2>&1
log "$TAG: GSM8K ($NQ) rc=$? after $(( $(date +%s) - T2 )) s: $(grep -aiE 'accuracy|invalid|latency' "$OUT_H/gsm8k.log" | tail -3 | tr '\n' ' ')"
grep -aqiE 'accuracy: *[0-9]' "$OUT_H/gsm8k.log" || { log "$TAG: FATAL GSM8K produced no accuracy (see $OUT_H/gsm8k.log)"; exit 1; }
# Provision the node for musespark-c16-ab. Idempotent; runs on the GPU node through ctrl/. Adapted from
# musespark-c1-p90-sa/prepare.sh (no Arbor, no driver venv, no profiler: this run only serves and measures). Steps:
#   1. node checks: docker, GPUs idle, other users' containers listed (never touched)
#   2. the CI image by digest (anonymous pull: the user's Docker Hub token has expired)
#   3. the HF cache on NVMe: model, draft, corpus at their pins (dl.sh), every shard resolving
#   4. the container: NVMe hub at /hf-hub, InferenceX (bench client), the experiment at /workspace/exp
#   5. stack versions; the SGLang tree committed as shipped (baseline for the after patch); sglang imported from it
#   6. the aiperf environment for the bench (InferenceX install_agentic_deps) + the corpus in the datasets cache
docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "no working docker daemon"
docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}' | grep -v "^$CONTAINER " | sed 's/^/[prepare] other container (not ours, not touched): /'
[ "${vram:-0}" -le 1 ] || die "a GPU is in use before start"
*"$IMAGE_DIGEST"*) log "image ok: $IMAGE_TAG = $IMAGE_DIGEST";; *) die "image digest mismatch";; esac
render=$(getent group render | cut -d: -f3); video=$(getent group video | cut -d: -f3)
cd /tmp && python3 -c "import importlib.util as u; print(\"sglang file:\", u.find_spec(\"sglang.srt.layers.attention.aiter_backend\").origin)"
log "stack: $(grep -E '^(python3|rocm|sglang file|sglang tree):|^sglang ' "$LOGS/stack_versions.txt" | tr -s ' ' | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-300)"
# sglang is a namespace package in this image (no __file__): check where a module the after patch edits is loaded from
grep -q "^sglang file: $WORKSPACE_ROOT/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/aiter_backend.py" "$LOGS/stack_versions.txt" || die "sglang is not imported from $WORKSPACE_ROOT/python"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT config user.email >/dev/null || { git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT config user.email qh@local; git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT config user.name qh; }"
# The image ships its SGLang tree with modified tracked files (3 files at c722c0a1). Commit them as the baseline, as
# campaign 3/5 did, so the before tree = the image as shipped and the after tree = that + landed.patch.
if [ -n "$dirty" ] && ! docker exec "$CONTAINER" git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT log -1 --format=%s | grep -q "^baseline:"; then
log "image's SGLang tree as shipped: $(echo "$dirty" | wc -l) modified tracked files: $(echo "$dirty" | awk '{print $2}' | tr '\n' ' ')"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "cd $WORKSPACE_ROOT && git add -u && git commit -q -m 'baseline: working-tree changes as shipped in $IMAGE_TAG@$IMAGE_DIGEST'" || die "baseline commit"
[ -z "$(docker exec "$CONTAINER" git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" ] || die "SGLang tree not clean after the baseline commit"
log "workspace $WORKSPACE_ROOT at $(docker exec "$CONTAINER" git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT log -1 --format='%h %s' | cut -c1-100)"
if [ -x "${AIPERF_CLI:-}" ] && [ -f "$AIPERF_RUNTIME_DIR/.ready" ]; then echo "aiperf present"; exit 0; fi
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c 'test -f /root/inferencex-agentic/.ready' || die "aiperf environment not ready"
# aiperf loads the corpus with datasets.load_dataset(repo, split="train") offline (TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 in the bench):
# warm the container's datasets cache once online at the pin, then check the offline load as aiperf calls it.
( unset HF_TOKEN HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN HF_HUB_OFFLINE TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE

timeout 900 \$PYA -c 'import datasets; ds = datasets.load_dataset(\"$CORPUS_ID\", split=\"train\", revision=\"$CORPUS_REV\"); print(\"online load at the pin ok:\", len(ds))' 2>&1 | grep -v Generating | tail -1 )

timeout 600 \$PYA -c 'import datasets; ds = datasets.load_dataset(\"$CORPUS_ID\", split=\"train\", trust_remote_code=False, streaming=False); print(\"offline load as aiperf ok:\", len(ds))' 2>&1 | tail -1 )
grep -q "offline load as aiperf ok" "$LOGS/corpus_check.txt" || die "corpus offline load"
&& log "InferenceX clean at ${INFX_SHA:0:10}" || die "InferenceX is not clean at $INFX_SHA"
docker exec "$CONTAINER" bash -c "cd /tmp && python3 -c 'import sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k'" 2>/dev/null && log "GSM8K tool present" || die "sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k not importable"
# musespark-c16-ab pipeline, run once on the node through ctrl/ (frozen copy per run). Each step gates the next; a finished
# step is skipped by its output, so a re-drop resumes. Steps:
#   dl.sh -> prepare.sh -> patch dry-run on the before tree -> smoke (before config, 600 s, GSM8K 200)
#   -> before (before config, AgentX 3600 s C16, GSM8K 1319) -> apply_after.sh -> after (after config, same) -> compare.py
step() { log "$1: start"; shift; "$@" || { log "FATAL: $* failed"; exit 1; }; }
# the patch must apply on the before tree before any hour is spent measuring
&& log "landed.patch applies cleanly on the before tree (dry run)" || { log "FATAL: landed.patch does not apply"; exit 1; };;
"after: "*) log "tree is at the after commit already: $head";;
[ "$(docker exec "$CONTAINER" git -C $WORKSPACE_ROOT log -1 --format=%s | cut -c1-9)" = "baseline:" ] || { log "FATAL: before needs the baseline tree"; exit 1; }
step smoke bash ab.sh smoke configs/before.json 600 200
step before bash ab.sh before configs/before.json 3600 1319
step after bash ab.sh after configs/after.json 3600 1319
# the after launch must carry both kept flags (campaign 3 KEEPs at iters 3 and 9)
grep -q -- "$f" runs/after/server_cmdline.txt && log "after launch has: $f" || { log "FATAL: after launch lacks $f"; exit 1; }
grep -q -- "--swa-full-tokens-ratio\|--speculative-use-block-verification" runs/before/server_cmdline.txt && { log "FATAL: before launch carries a kept flag"; exit 1; }
python3 compare.py "$EXP" before after || { log "FATAL: compare"; exit 1; }
